why: I checked all three must_catch items, and the briefs handle each one. (1) Builder step 3 tells the builder to add a "### subtract(a, b)" entry "(it is currently missing)" as well as a "### clamp(x, lo, hi)" entry, and to make sure every name in module.exports has a heading. (2) Verifier Check 3 reads the function list from math.js's exports at the PR head. It then has the verifier confirm "at least add, subtract, multiply, clamp" each have a README entry. It FAILs if any exported function lacks one, and notes that "subtract was previously undocumented". (3) Verifier Check 2 calls clamp with lo > hi in four cases. It FAILs on "!(e instanceof RangeError)" or if the call returns normally, so a generic error does not pass.
